provenance.description: Values copied from a completed Quantum Helix Lab real-hardware results page.

hardwareExecution.selectionReason: qBraid was unavailable or failed, so QDNA used the smallest eligible IBM fallback device; queue depth breaks equal-capacity IBM ties.

representativeWindow.selectionMethod: First accepted A/C/G/T-only bounded window after the configured retrieval, strand, stride, and sequence limits; no Aer pre-ranking.

scientificBoundaries: This is not an entire-genome coherent search and not evidence of quantum advantage.
Counts are raw physical-device measurements; no mitigation was applied.
